context: Push the branch and open the real PR against develop (include the shim follow-up fixes if ready). After merge, correct completed_pr on all six items — note todo update does not expose completed_pr, so this needs either a small CLI extension or a sanctioned patch performed under a held maintenance freeze that ALSO writes an events row. Record a corrective audit event on the migration item documenting the 2026-08-07 out-of-band blocked_reason/preserves patch (before/after summary). Consider a guard: document that raw-SQL hosted patches are prohibited outside freeze + manual event.
description: Adversarial review (H2/M5): six done items (todo-db-auto-provision-mint-failure-visibility, todo-wrapper-silently-falls-back-to-local-database-20260805, todo-db-cutover-findings-sequencing, todo-db-shim-post-extraction-verbs, tracker-cutover-needs-a-write-freeze-not-a-claim-check, cutover-record-corrections-and-quiescence-probe-v2) cite completed_pr=1642, which does not exist on GitHub. Commits 1fa5972b9f and 8c2702a830 exist only on local develop and branch claude/batch-tracker-db-reliability-0eb0d1 — origin/develop is at 99e245db43. Separately, the migration item migrate-hosted-tracker-db-to-todo-db-0-3-schema had preserves/blocked_reason patched via raw SQL through connect_hosted with ZERO events rows since 2026-08-07 — the patch bypassed the audit trail that the quiescence fingerprint depends on (every mutation must log an event).

preserves.behavior: done/dropped lifecycle states of the six batch items are not reverted
every hosted mutation leaves an events row

verifications.command: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && git fetch -q origin develop && git merge-base --is-ancestor 8c2702a830 origin/develop

cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && _project/scripts/todo show todo-db-shim-post-extraction-verbs --json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys,subprocess; pr=json.load(sys.stdin).get('completed_pr'); sys.exit(1 if not pr else subprocess.run(['gh','pr','view',str(pr)],capture_output=True).returncode)"
verifications.description: completed_pr on shim item resolves to a real merged PR
verifications.expected: gh resolves the recorded PR number

verifications.command: cd $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) && sqlite3 .todo-db/replica.db "SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE item_id='migrate-hosted-tracker-db-to-todo-db-0-3-schema' AND at >= '2026-08-08T12:00:00Z'" | grep -qv '^0$'
verifications.description: migration item has a post-2026-08-08 audit event
